diagnostic:
S1 Replace is GREEN through the production router: the us-iis-07 lane runs 11
scenarios / 164 steps, all passing, and the whole instance-integration-setup
lane 116 scenarios / 1297 steps, so nothing shipped regressed. cargo xtask
smoke prints "xtask smoke :: all gates green".

Design followed as projected. Store::replace_secrets_key is one transaction
under the instance-integrations advisory lock: the compare-and-set on the
stored key id (replace_stored_key, added to the check-arch fenced-writer list)
in place of Generate's absence check, the shared reseal_sealed_values walk,
upsert_key_check, the Activity::SecretsKeyReplaced line carrying the
credentials it sealed again, and the version bump; a refusal from the closure
and a lost compare-and-set each roll back (D2, D3, L1, L9, C3). KeyMode gains
replaces(unopenable_values) and KeyOffer a Replace arm with opens(), so one
closed decision answers what the page offers and what the door applies (D4,
L7). The confirm page is ReadOnlyDoor::SecretsKeyReplace over
[PageRead::Snapshot], so the GET cannot reach a write (L4, C2); the existing
listing unit test gained its row. SavedCredentials in the new
secrets_key_rotation.rs owns the I-22 count and the I-23/I-24 copy forms, with
the L10 property over 0..=8 connections crossed with the saved app present or
absent and its four must-include cases, the sentences read against the locked
copy table. SavedNotice gained Replaced(n) as the one-shot session notice with
the wire name "replaced:{n}"; of_wire still answers None for a name or a count
it does not know (D7, L5, Y9). The acting replica answers after the shared
Integrations::reboot, so it opens every credential at once (D3).

P3's two completion obligations are discharged in the slice's own verification
commands, not as new oracle cases: in crates/foundry-store/tests/
iis_instance_store.rs a replacement refused on the first connection credential
and on the saved app's secrets, and one whose compare-and-set matches no row,
each leave every observed table byte-identical; in foundry-app
integrations::handlers a refusing store double leaves the answer
ReplaceAnswer::AskAgain, which carries no SavedNotice at all, while a
committing double earns Replaced(SavedNotice::Replaced(3)) and a KeyChanged
answer leaves the page as it is - so no I-24 can be read for a write that
rolled back.

Two deviations from the projected target list, both mechanical and named here.
(1) crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/mod.rs is not in the S1 target list but
must declare the new module, and crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/worker.rs
is not either, while its existing InstanceKeyWrites test double must gain the
new trait method to compile; both are one-line lane edits the slice needs.
(2) GeneratePlan gained reseal_under(opening, slot, sealed) as the single
implementation and the shipped reseal(instance, ...) now delegates to it in one
line, rather than being renamed: three existing call sites (two keys.rs unit
tests and crates/foundry-app/tests/iis_admin_cli_rotate.rs) read reseal, and
adapting tests I do not own was the worse trade. There is one implementation,
so no second authority over the re-seal.

Two existing unit tables were extended, not weakened, because Replace is now
offered where Sealed held no offer: the_page_follows_the_mode and
generate_and_move_are_withheld_under_i4_in_every_mode read Some(KeyOffer::
Replace) for Sealed without I-4 and None under I-4, and the latter's door loop
now covers all three doors. No oracle, support or feature record was touched.
No refactor was taken under the L1-L4 latitude, so no refactor commit precedes
this one.

One finding for the architect, outside this slice: the architecture Agreement
names the start-over wire name "secrets_key_started_over", while the shipped
0033 action CHECK constraint admits 'started_over'. S3 cannot write
"secrets_key_started_over" without a migration that K5 forbids. Not my slice to
decide; raised so DESIGN reconciles it before S3.

Local runs and this diagnostic replace neither independent review nor EXAMINE.
